q: The West Bengal Public Safety and Control of Anti-Social Activities Bill, 2026 was passed by the West Bengal Legislative Assembly on:

explanation: The four identified mega ports were Deendayal Port, Jawaharlal Nehru Port, Paradip Port and Mundra Port.
